mapper.select: SELECT m.member_no, m.member_id, m.password, m.name, m.nick_name, m.email, m.phone_number, m.zip_code, m.basic_address, m.detail_address, m.gender, m.birthday, m.refresh_token, m.created_at, m.purchase_count, m.bank_name, m.bank_code, m.account_holder_name, m.status, r.member_role_no, r.role_name FROM member m JOIN member_role r ON m.member_no = r.member_no WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET refresh_token = #{refreshToken} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (member_no, member_id, password, name, nick_name, email, phone_number) VALUES (#{memberNo}, #{memberId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{nickName}, #{email}, #{phoneNumber})
mapper.select: SELECT member_no, member_id, name, nick_name, email, phone_number, zip_code, basic_address, detail_address, gender, birthday, created_at, purchase_count, bank_name, bank_code, account_holder_name, status FROM member WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET name = #{name}, nick_name = #{nickName}, email = #{email}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, gender = #{gender}, birthday = #{birthday}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, basic_address = #{basicAddress}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, bank_name = #{bankName}, bank_code = #{bankCode}, account_holder_name = #{accountHolderName} WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}
